population.kidComparison: About 68 million people live in France, the largest country by land area in Western Europe.

geography.climate: Cool winters and mild summers in the north, snowy mountains in the Alps, and warm sunny weather along the Mediterranean coast.
geography.terrain: Mix of coastal plains and inland terrain.

flag.description: Three vertical bands of blue, white, and red.

anthem.title: La Marseillaise
anthem.summary: Written in 1792, known around the world for its energetic, marching melody.

exploration.didYouKnow: The Eiffel Tower actually grows about 15 centimeters (6 inches) taller in the summer because heat makes the iron expand!

regionalTraits: Sketches landmarks in a tiny pocket sketchbook
Can identify dozens of cheeses by smell alone
Always wears a neatly knotted scarf
